purpose: Join existing failure procedures and derived damage topology to a deterministic repair-attempt receipt chain without granting repair or fault-clear authority.
spare_rule: Any planned spare consumption requires an explicit spare verification receipt; no SKU or compatibility is invented.
fabricated_part_rule: Any fabricated repair part requires an explicit part validation receipt; fabrication capability alone grants no repair capability.
clearance_boundary: Eligibility produces a fault-clearance candidate only. It does not modify authoritative runtime or clear a fault.
